eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Delhi (NCT) resident for >=5 years; Haryana/UP NCR excluded.
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: Widow, divorced, separated, or destitute women in distress.

benefit.summary_hi: दिल्ली की विधवा, तलाकशुदा या परित्यक्त संकटग्रस्त महिलाओं को ₹2,500/माह (अधिसूचना अनुसार) मासिक पेंशन।
benefit.summary_en: Monthly DBT pension (typically ₹2,500/month [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]) for widows & destitute women.

benefit_summary.en: Monthly DBT pension (typically ₹2,500/month [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]) for widows & destitute women.

documents_required: Husband's Death Certificate / Divorce or Separation Proof

anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Nominal authorized CFC/CSC facilitation fee only (always take printed receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
